# <span id="aanchor286"></span> FLOWCAL Data Condenser

The FLOWCAL Data Condenser utility condenses datetime effective records to help maintain database stability and performance. Occasionally, daily characteristics or analysis records are created even if parameter values did not change. This utility finds all records with matching parameter values and creates one record for the span. The utility can also be used on periodic data when multiple revisions were created but no data was changed.

The FLOWCAL Data Condenser utility should only be used under the direction of product Support staff.

The FC Username and Password should be that of a FLOWCAL user, such as a service account user.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Runtime Options">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Runtime Options</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Runtime Options">

- **Meter Number and GQ Number**
  - {Blank} – Do not review any meters/GQ sources.
  - \[ALL\] – Review every meter/GQ source and condense data if possible.
  - Specific meter or GQ source numbers can also be specified so that condensing is only performed for the meter/GQ source in question.
- **Start Date** - Date of first data to be condensed.
- **Do Meter Periodic** - Check this flag if you would like to condense history records (FC_METER_PERIODIC_VALUES)
- **Mtr Per Special** ‐ Only use this flag if directed by your Flow‐Cal technical support representative.
- **Do Mtr Char** - Check this flag if you would like to condense Meter Characteristic records (FC_METER_CHARACTERISTIC) or Meter Analysis records (FC_METER_ANALYSIS)
- **Do Meter Exceptions** - Check this flag if you would like to condense Meter Exceptions. This will only condense duplicate exception (in a case where FLOWCAL incorrectly created duplicates).
- **Reverse Alphabetic order** - Check this flag if the \[ALL\] setting is used and you have two utilities running in parallel. This allows the utilities to begin work at opposite ends of the meter/GQ source list. This setting can be used to reduce the time it takes the utility to look at all meter/GQ sources.
- **Stop on Errors** - Check this flag to make the utility to stop if an error is encountered; the utility will wait for the user to click OK to acknowledge the error.
- **Fix Gaps Overlaps Only** - Check this flag to only fix gaps and overlaps for specified items. This is similar to running the duration fix utility.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Scheduling">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Scheduling FLOWCAL Data Condenser</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Scheduling">

The FLOWCAL Data Condenser utility can be scheduled via Windows Scheduled Tasks. Select the FcDataCondenser.exe file and append ‘CMDLINE’ as the parameter. When the schedule runs, the utility uses the database login specified in FLOWCAL Service Configuration and the runtime options specified in FcDebugOptions.cfg.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 328;height: 367;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcDebugOptions">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />FLOWCAL Data Condenser FcDebugOptions</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcDebugOptions">

\[FCDATACONDENSER\]

condense_meters = Y, N, or blank

condense_gq_sources = Y, N, or blank

time_frame_type = A - all of time, C - current month, M ‐ months, W - weeks

number_of_time_frames = 1 to 120 (weeks or months)

condense_meter_periodic = Y, N, or blank

meter_periodic_special = Y, N, or blank

condense_characteristic = Y, N, or blank

condense_analysis = Y, N, or blank

condense_meter_exceptions = Y, N, or blank

reverse_alphabetical_order = Y, N, or blank

fix_gaps_overlaps_only = Y, N, or blank (when set to Y, only gaps and overlaps are fixed)

</div>
